scope: scope-2d-ui-first: shadcn Radix + Tailwind + Motion; approved boards 08 and 09
status: adopted and verified in real Electron

components.Button: Uses the existing shared components/ui.tsx Button across account/auth/settings actions
components.Input: username, account and password fields; native password autocomplete retained
components.Tabs: controlled login/register tabs, keyboard Arrow/Home/End selection
components.Switch: desktop, notification, privacy and sync policies
components.Checkbox: remember account and opt-in secure login
components.RestoreChoice: Shared Radix Select implements the merge/replace choice; no local radio-group implementation
components.AppDialog: restore preview; title, children, onClose, busy; focus trap/return, Escape, no accidental close while saving

motion: Foundation PageTransition/AppMotionProvider, account AnimatedList, AppDialog -> MotionPanel; saved animation preference and reduced motion at load verified
assets: Only approved illustration regions of boards 08/09 are used as CSS artwork. Forms, data, native file dialogs and host policies remain live components. No design board is used as a whole page.
dependencyPolicy: Foundation alone owns package/lock, shared components and motion; this module adds no root dependencies
